answer_1.quote: Image-based natural language generation (NLG) has great potential for productive applications in accessibility, image search, creative writing, and navigational instruction tasks, among other areas.
answer_1.outputs: descriptions and captions grounded in images with contextual information

answer_2.quote: Currently established evaluations of text generated from images rely on multiple references to reliably estimate performance. As suggested in previous work , we consider CIDEr  to be most appropriate for our setting.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 421 participants over Amazon's Mechanical Turk, who were paid $2.60 for participation with an average completion time of 12 minutes ($13/hr).
answer_4.guideline: Participants assessed how useful the text would be to help someone imagine the picture (rated from not useful to very useful), and how much they learned from the text that they couldn't have learned from the image (rated from nothing to a lot).
